Author: @AutumWieder-oo9xh
Content:
I’d love to see y’all try this if you haven’t already! It’s kind of a fun, thickums breakfast dish!
Goldenrod Eggs:
Boil 6 eggs or so, just as many as you’d like! Set them aside to cool and start a roux with butter and flour and then add some of that good parm and white cheddar and with either cream or milk, I just use what I’ve got on hand at the time. Salt and pepper it and while the sauce is getting to your desired thickness, add in the whites of the boiled eggs, chopped roughly to the sauce. I like them a bit bigger, not super finely chopped.
Toast some fresh sourdough bread in butter, pour the sauce over like biscuits and gravy style. Then crumble the boiled egg yolks on top as a garnish with fresh ground black pepper. 
Some optional garnishes are smoked paprika and green onions as well. Might try it with both and see what you think if you’d like! I’d love to know! Thanks for all your content! You’re a legend!💪🏼🙌🏻
